reason: V3-08 audit decision is repair. The candidate is a non-empty delta (3 files, 110 insertions, hasDelta=true) repairing the trusted finalizer blocker from Actions run 35496233889. The core repairs are sound: (1) removing the unconditional adb kill-server/start-server restart before the golden path that destabilised uiautomator server registration causing empty dumps and Demarrer timeouts; (2) raising the uiautomator dump timeout from 45s to 60s to accommodate degraded API 35 x86_64 cold starts; (3) screenshot reusing the fresh dump cache to avoid redundant 30-60s dumps. However, the candidate introduces a new crash-detection feature in waitFor() that is non-functional: adb shell pidof exits 1 when the app is dead, execFileSync throws, the catch swallows the error, and the if (!pid) relaunch branch is unreachable. The guarding test is a weak static-string check that passes regardless of behavior. The candidate is retained as WIP baseline. The next Builder cycle must fix the crash-detection error-status handling and strengthen its test before the next finalizer attempt. All V3-01 through V3-07 remain accepted with zero regression.
